purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Gatanga Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: This constituency's official upload is a 4-page condensed scan (each PDF page holds multiple original tally sheets; the printed page header on the final page reads 'CON 110 05/18'), so the ordinary green-shading TOTAL-row auto-locator does not apply. The TOTAL row was located manually on the final page (page 4 of 4), immediately above the 'Agents or Candidates' block and the Constituency Returning Officer's signature, and re-read at 300 DPI. The row digits are unambiguous.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image at 120 DPI (full-page layout) and again at 300 DPI (close crop) with identical results both times. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
